title: A Validation Study to Evaluate the Performance of Caption Health Lung Guidance and Interpretation
official: A Validation Study to Evaluate the Performance of Caption Health Lung Guidance and Interpretation
summary: The purpose of this study is to assess the efficacy of Caption LungAI.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients over the age of 18
* Patients presenting to the hospital or outpatient setting with shortness of breath and suspected B-lines.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients in extremis/in whom a research lung ultrasound would not normally be performed due to other priorities

sites.f: The Moses H. Cone Memorial Hospital
